title: Statement
summary: A statement is an expression eligible to be asserted, denied, proved, or evaluated in a model.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared formal language context is fixed.

content.plain: A statement is an expression eligible to be asserted, denied, proved, or evaluated in a model.
content.exact: For a language L, Sent(L) is the class of closed well-formed formulas: formulas with no free variables.
content.example: ∀x (x=x) is a sentence in a language with equality.
content.caveat: The same written string may fail to be a statement in another grammar.
